Dogger.label: Dogger (4)
Dogger.tekst: Southerly 2-4, increasing southwest 4-5, later possibly 6, occasional showers, risk of a thunderstorm and hail , visibility good, in precipitation moderate to poor, waveheight around 1.5 meter, decreasing around 1.0 meter.

German Bight.label: German Bight (4)
German Bight.tekst: Variable 2-4, soon increasing south 4-5, veering southwest, mainly first occasional showers, risk of a thunderstorm and hail , visibility good, in precipitation moderate to poor, waveheight around 1.5 meter, in the south and gradually everywhere around 1.0 meter.

Humber.label: Humber (4)
Humber.tekst: South 3-4, soon increasing southwest 4-5, first occasional showers, risk of a thunderstorm and hail, later fewer showers, visibility good, in precipitation moderate to poor, waveheight 0.5-1.0 meter, later increasing around 1.0 meter.

Thames.label: Thames (4)
Thames.tekst: Southwest 3-4, soon increasing 4-5, later 5-6, later occasional showers, risk of a thunderstorm, gusts and hail , visibility good, in precipitation moderate to poor, waveheight 0.5-1.0 meter, later increasing around 1.0 meter.
